content_sections.heading: About BHEL
content_sections.text: Bharat Heavy Electricals Limited is a Govt. of India Undertaking. This engagement is advertised by its Human Resource Management office, Power Sector Eastern Region, Kolkata, and the notice carries the date 13.11.2026.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice states a requirement of a total of 6 hours duty a day for 5 days in a week. This is met either by 2 posts for 3 hours duty a day or by 1 post for 6 hours duty a day. The notice does not print a separate vacancy count for each post code. A candidate meeting all the criteria can apply for a maximum of two post codes.

rows.timing: 10.00 AM to 5.00 PM (Lunch break from 01:00 PM to 2:00 PM)

content_sections.heading: Qualification and Experience
content_sections.text: Candidates must also be a member of the Medical Council of India or a State Medical Council. The upper age limit is 65 years as on 01.11.2026. The notice adds that the age limit may be relaxed up to 70 years with specific approval from the Competent Authority. No minimum age is printed. For the discipline-specific eligibility of each post, candidates should check the official notification.

rows.qualification: MBBS (from a recognized institute/ university); MBBS degree recognized by the Medical Council of India
rows.experience: Minimum One (01) Year post qualification experience as on 01.11.2026

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: The remuneration is Rs. 500/- per hour per day, payable only for the day on which the PTMC performs the duty. The engagement is payable on an hourly basis. Tenure: purely temporary basis for a period of one year. Subsequent renewals are limited to a maximum of 3 years, subject to satisfactory performance and at the discretion of the Management. Joining: the tentative date of joining is in the first week of December 2026. Working hours: minimum 3 hours and maximum 6 hours a day, for a maximum of 5 days a week (Monday to Friday). There is no work on BHEL declared holidays for Kolkata. Management has the right to change the working hours based on requirement and availability of candidates. Notice period: one month on either side for discontinuing the part time engagement. Conveyance: for local travel up to 30 KMs one-way, conveyance is payable on actual basis with an upper ceiling of Rs. 4500/- per month. Beyond 30 KMs one-way, the upper ceiling is Rs. 6000/- per month on case to case basis. Payment of remuneration and conveyance is against submission of an invoice, as an independent professional rendering the services.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is through personal interview of eligible candidates. The interview date and venue are not specified in the notice. No TA/DA is paid to candidates called for interview. The selected candidate must produce a medical fitness certificate from a registered medical practitioner at the time of joining. The notice says the applicant should have sound health and the appointment is subject to meeting the good health standards.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for BHEL Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Download the blank application form for engagement of Part Time Medical Consultant from the BHEL websites https://pser.bhel.com/ or https://careers.bhel.in . Fill in the form and attach the relevant documents, self-attested. Superscribe the envelope "Application for post of PTMC". Post it to SR MANAGER (HR), HRM Dept., BHEL BHAWAN, BLOCK-DJ, PLOT-9/1, SECTOR-II, SALT LAKE CITY, KOLKATA- 700 091. Alternatively, send the application by email to [email protected] . Make sure the application reaches on or before 28.11.2026 (17.30 hrs).

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: DOB proof - SSC/Matriculation Certificate. MBBS Certificate and Mark Sheet/s. Registration Certificate for MBBS issued by Medical Council of India or by State Medical Council. Retired professionals: Superannuation/Retirement along with Relieving order from the previous employer where he/she was engaged prior to applying to BHEL. Working professionals: Last Salary Slip / Joining Order.

faq.question: Q1. How many posts are there in BHEL Recruitment 2026 for PTMC?
faq.answer: The notice states 2 posts for 3 hours duty a day, or 1 post for 6 hours duty a day, to meet a total requirement of 6 hours a day for 5 days a week.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the BHEL PTMC posts?
faq.answer: The application must reach on or before 28 November 2026 (17.30 hrs). Applications received after the last date are not considered.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for BHEL PTMC (GDMO)?
faq.answer: Candidates need an MBBS degree recognized by the Medical Council of India, membership of the Medical Council of India or a State Medical Council, and minimum one year of post qualification experience as on 01.11.2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for BHEL PTMC?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 65 years as on 01.11.2026. It may be relaxed up to 70 years with specific approval from the Competent Authority.

faq.question: Q5. What is the remuneration for BHEL Part Time Medical Consultants?
faq.answer: The remuneration is Rs. 500/- per hour per day, only for the day on which the PTMC performs the duty. Conveyance charges are payable up to the ceilings stated in the notice.

faq.question: Q6. How can I apply for BHEL Recruitment 2026 PTMC?
faq.answer: Download the blank form from https://pser.bhel.com/ or https://careers.bhel.in. Send it with self-attested documents by post to SR MANAGER (HR), HRM Dept., BHEL BHAWAN, Kolkata, or by email to [email protected].

faq.question: Q7. How will candidates be selected?
faq.answer: Selection is through personal interview of eligible candidates. No TA/DA is paid to candidates called for interview.

faq.question: Q8. Is the BHEL PTMC engagement permanent?
faq.answer: No. It is purely a temporary engagement for one year, payable on an hourly basis. Renewals are limited to a maximum of 3 years, subject to satisfactory performance and at the discretion of the Management.

faq.question: Q9. Can I apply for more than one post code?
faq.answer: Yes. A candidate meeting all the criteria can apply for a maximum of two post codes.

faq.question: Q10. What is the notice period for the PTMC engagement?
faq.answer: There is a notice period of one month on either side for discontinuing the part time engagement.
